summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built real-time embedded C and C++ firmware on STM32 Cortex-M4 and Arduino microcontrollers using interrupts, timers, ADC, and FreeRTOS, and integrated it with Linux-based Jetson and Raspberry Pi systems. Resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures in a multi-device robotics system to reach 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for Git version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed Cortex-M4 peripherals directly in bare-metal embedded C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on STM32; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands from YOLOv8 object tracking on NVIDIA Jetson, with user override.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures (servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping (gripper close at 25 mm); implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a Linux systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles (4-bit A/B transition state machine on hardware interrupts) and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM on Arduino Due.
Built closed-loop heading correction from encoder odometry and a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect; led coding team to DD Robocon 2023 Stage 3.
